title: Legacy of the Kingdomborn
description: Legacy of the Kingdomborn is a small rpg style modpack  based around origins mod
body:
Welcome to Legacy of the Kingdomborn Modpack.

Legacys Of the Kingdomborn Modpack is an rpg style modpack. Note This modpack is recomend for 40 players server not solo player. At the start of the modpack you pick between 4 orgins Depending what you pick will deside where you spawn. The goals of this modpack is to be the last kingdom alive.

Hope you have a blast
